The '''Coronas''' was a street gang on [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] the Coronas sided with the Sith and cooperated to cripple the Corellian resistance during the Battle of Corellia but they were driven out of the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] region when [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Danod]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] enlisted the aid of the Republic forces on the planet. They were secretly guided by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Councilor [[Harmon Torvix]].<ref name="The Old Republic" />
